owasp_top10_mapping.notes: RLS on profiles/subscriptions. Frontend RBAC via RoleGate/RouteGuard. Domain data in Base44 has unknown RLS.
HTTPS via Vercel. Supabase handles encryption at rest. No custom crypto.
Supabase JS SDK uses parameterized queries. No raw SQL in frontend. escapeHtml() in TBBM email builder.
Dual data system (Base44 + Supabase) creates undefined security boundary.
CSP: unsafe-inline + unsafe-eval on script-src. HSTS absent. X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies absent.
npm audit not run (no network access in sandbox). Run: npm audit --audit-level=high
Supabase Auth with 5s timeout, state machine, AuthContext. No hardcoded admin email bypass in auth flow.
No SLSA provenance. CI absent — no artifact signing.
console.error() only. No structured logs. No audit trail for admin operations.
No server-side URL fetch in frontend. Edge Functions use known endpoints.

dangerous_innerhtml.content: Developer-controlled CSS theme variables — not user input. Low XSS risk but requires unsafe-inline.

risks.title: JSX syntax error in Workouts.jsx
risks.mitigation: Replace '</' closing fragment with '))}' to close .map() callback correctly. Verified fix with npm run typecheck.

risks.title: CSP unsafe-inline+unsafe-eval renders XSS protection non-functional
risks.mitigation: Remove unsafe-eval from CSP. Remove unsafe-inline from script-src. Add HSTS header. Requires replacing dangerouslySetInnerHTML in chart.jsx with CSS custom property approach.

risks.title: Base44 SDK as primary data backend — 186 call sites in 54 files
risks.mitigation: Full Supabase migration required. APPROVAL REQUEST pending. Estimated effort: large. Must define Supabase schema for each domain entity and migrate data.

risks.title: No CI pipeline
risks.mitigation: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with lint, typecheck, build, test, and bundle-budget stages.

risks.title: No E2E / staging smoke tests
risks.mitigation: Add Playwright E2E suite covering signup, login, logout, session refresh, role-based navigation.

risks.title: No automated accessibility gate
risks.mitigation: Add @axe-core/playwright or pa11y-ci to CI. Fix contrast violations on primary buttons.

risks.title: Main bundle 2.57 MiB; LCP 5.7 s (3x over budget)
risks.mitigation: Add manualChunks to vite.config.js. Lazy-load pages with React.lazy(). Target: LCP <= 2500 ms.

risks.title: html[lang] never updated on locale change
Dual subscription systems (Base44 + Supabase conflict)
risks.mitigation: Resolved when RISK-003 (Base44 migration) is complete. Designate Supabase subscriptions as single source of truth.

risks.title: No LGPD/GDPR consent layer or /privacy route
risks.mitigation: Add consent banner, /privacy route, Supabase-backed account deletion, and data export covering all Supabase tables.

risks.title: 73 ESLint errors block CI
risks.mitigation: Run npm run lint:fix then manually remove remaining unused imports.

risks.title: grant_admin_*.mjs scripts hardcode admin email and accept SERVICE_ROLE_KEY as CLI arg
risks.mitigation: Add to .gitignore or delete from repo. Use Supabase Dashboard for admin grants.
